WINNING TEAM

Know our team

Shay Dayan
VP of Business Strategy Development

Shay has a rich background in senior management of large companies and corporations. He advocates business strategies, believes that "a business does not stand on dreams but on numbers" and knows how to crack the exact ROI for each product and project.More info

Daniel Yanay
Product Designer

Daniel s a talented and creative Product Designer, with extensive knowledge and experience in User Experience (UX) and User Interface (UI) design. He specializes in understanding user needs, planning and designing intuitive interfaces, and creating interactive elements that enhance the overall product experience.More info

Bar Pat’el
Full-Stack Developer

Bar can manage end-to-end projects (both front end and back end). He assists in integrating projects, managing databases, linking different components, recommending innovative technologies, and working with existing frameworks and CMSs. Bar has a keen interest in applications and a sharp eye for the latest trends. He sees every new development in the market as an opportunity worth exploiting, and loves to help the global developer community with articles and tips for honing their craft. More info

Arik Wald
Software Architect

As a System Architect, Arik is a professional manager who is responsible for planning, designing and initiating projects. Arik has an MCS (Master of Computer Science and Software Engineering) degree from the University of Iowa, USA and has rich experience of over 20 years in full stack and embedded development which makes him an extensive source of knowledge and information. In addition, he specializes in frontend and mobile applications. Arik’s motto is “Technology is merely a tool for us to use when developing a product, not the other way around”. Hence, it is crucial for us to adapt to any technology as necessary. More info

Tal Valante
Full-Stack Developer

Tal Valante has two passions in life: full-stack programming and creative writing. About Us

Our Partners

LiveDNS

LiveDNS is a top IT solutions provider in Israel, certified as Microsoft's Tier 1 partner for Office 365 and Azure. They are the largest website hosting company and domain registrar in Israel, meeting high-quality and security standards. LiveDNS offers diverse cloud solutions, virtual server management, network maintenance, backups, and innovative cybersecurity. They are authorized resellers for leading information security manufacturers and the official Israeli representative for global WAF and CDN companies.
